raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Rows from the new 'v2' collector, which starts in batch 12 and has no change note, carry timestamps shifted +6h versus legacy, consistent with UTC versus local UTC-6: v2 activity starts at 12:00 while legacy starts at 06:00. As a result, evening v2 transactions roll into 00:00-06:00 of the next day, producing the spurious 2026-01-19 rows and out-of-hours counts. The fix shifts v2 timestamps back 6 hours before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
